handoff.salientSummary: Implemented POST /api/v1/evaluations endpoint with complete request validation, model/dataset lookup, DB record creation, and Redis status caching. All 5 test cases pass and manual verification confirms 202 response with UUID task_id and proper error handling for invalid/missing fields.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Created EvaluationHandler with CreateEvaluation method that validates model/dataset fields, checks against supported lists via ModelRepository and DatasetRepository, creates evaluation record with UUID v4 task ID in PostgreSQL, sets Redis status to pending, and returns 202 Accepted with Location header. Implemented ModelRepository and DatasetRepository for querying models and datasets from database. Added ErrNotFound error constant for proper error handling. Created comprehensive test suite covering all validation contract assertions (VAL-API-001 through VAL-API-007). Wired up handler in main.go with proper dependency injection.

commandsRun.observation: All tests pass including TestCreateEvaluation_ValidRequest, TestCreateEvaluation_MissingModel, TestCreateEvaluation_MissingDataset, TestCreateEvaluation_InvalidModel, TestCreateEvaluation_InvalidDataset
